blocks.text: So'z tartibi: fe'l va to'ldiruvchi yonma-yon

O'zbek tilida fe'l odatda gapning **oxirida** turadi: «Men ingliz tilida juda yaxshi **gapiraman**». Tartib: ega — to'ldiruvchi — fe'l. Ingliz tilida esa tartib boshqacha: ega — **fe'l** — to'ldiruvchi, keyin esa «qanday?», «qayerda?», «qachon?»: I **speak** English very well. O'zbekchada so'zlarni qo'shimchalar bog'lab turadi, shuning uchun tartibni erkinroq o'zgartirish mumkin («Ingliz tilida men yaxshi gapiraman»). Inglizchada qo'shimcha yo'q — kim nima qilganini faqat **tartib** ko'rsatadi: Aziz loves Lola ≠ Lola loves Aziz.

Eng muhim qoida: **fe'l va to'ldiruvchi orasiga hech narsa qo'yilmaydi**. O'zbekchada «juda», «har kuni», «kecha» kabi so'zlar fe'ldan oldin keladi. Ularni inglizchaga xuddi shu joyda o'tkazsangiz, xato chiqadi: ular fe'l va to'ldiruvchi o'rtasiga tushib qoladi. To'g'ri yo'l — avval fe'l + to'ldiruvchi, keyin qolgan hammasi.

rows: U ingliz tilida juda yaxshi gapiradi.
He reads every day a newspaper.
I met at the station Tom.

items.text: We **love our new flat** a lot.

blocks.text: very much, a lot, well — to'ldiruvchidan keyin

«Qanchalik?» va «qanday?» savollariga javob beradigan so'zlar — **very much, a lot, well, badly, quickly, carefully** (86-dars) — to'ldiruvchidan **keyin** keladi. O'zbekchada ular fe'ldan oldin turadi («juda **yaxshi ko'raman**», «tez **yozadi**»), inglizchada esa gap oxiriga suriladi: I like it **very much**. She writes letters **quickly**. To'ldiruvchi bo'lmasa, ular to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fe'ldan keyin keladi: She sings **beautifully**.

To'ldiruvchi qancha uzun bo'lmasin, u baribir fe'ldan keyin darhol keladi: I **bought a new jacket and two shirts** in the sale. «I bought in the sale a new jacket» — xato. «She speaks very good English» — to'g'ri, chunki bu yerda **good** — sifat, u **English** otiga tegishli: = She speaks English very well.

Gapda joy (qayerga? qayerda?) va vaqt (qachon? qancha vaqt?) bo'lsa, inglizchada odatda **joy oldin, vaqt keyin** keladi: I go **to work every day**. We arrived **in London at six**. She was born **in Samarkand in 1998**. O'zbekchada esa ko'pincha teskari: «**Har kuni ishga** boraman», «**1998-yilda Samarqandda** tug'ilgan». To'liq tartib: ega + fe'l + to'ldiruvchi + **joy** + **vaqt**.

items.text: My parents got married **in Tashkent in 1995**.
I'll meet you **at the station at five**.
Did you sleep **at home last night**?

blocks.text: Vaqt gap boshida ham kelishi mumkin

Vaqt ifodasini gap boshiga chiqarish ham mumkin — bu o'zbekchaga yaqinroq va ko'pincha vaqtga urg'u beradi: **Last summer** we went to Khiva. **On Sundays** I visit my grandparents. Lekin vaqt baribir fe'l va to'ldiruvchi orasiga tushmaydi: «We went last summer to Khiva» — noqulay; «I visit on Sundays my grandparents» — xato.

items.text: **Every morning** Dilnoza walks her dog in the park.
items.translation: **Har kuni ertalab** Dilnoza itini parkda sayr qildiradi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari (o'zbekcha tartibni ko'chirish): «I English speak.» → **I speak English.**; «I like very much football.» → **I like football very much.**; «He drinks every morning coffee.» → **He drinks coffee every morning.**; «We yesterday went to the cinema.» → **We went to the cinema yesterday.** yoki **Yesterday we went to the cinema.**; «I every day go to work.» → **I go to work every day.**

Formula: **Kim? → nima qiladi? → nimani? → qanday? → qayerda? → qachon?** Fe'lni hech qachon oxirga qoldirmang — u egadan keyin darhol keladi. Vaqtni xohlasangiz gap boshiga ko'chiring, lekin fe'l bilan to'ldiruvchi orasiga emas.
Istisno bor: **always, often, never** kabi so'zlar fe'ldan **oldin** keladi (I **always** drink tea) — 94-dars. **still, yet, already** — 95-dars. Ikki to'ldiruvchi (give **me** the book) — 96-dars.

examples.title: Verb + object together: **like tea** very much
examples.description: Fe'l va to'ldiruvchi yonma-yon: **like tea**, **love her job**. very much, a lot — to'ldiruvchidan keyin, gap oxirida. O'zbekchada esa «juda» fe'ldan oldin.

sentences.text: Madina **loves her job** very much.
We **enjoyed the concert** a lot.
Do you **like football** very much? — Not really.
I **miss my family** a lot when I'm abroad.
Thank you — I **appreciate your help** very much.
Our children **love their grandparents** very much.
James didn't **like the food** in the hotel very much.
Everyone **enjoyed your speech** a lot, Aziz!
If you **like the dress** so much, why don't you buy it?
sentences.translation: **Ko'ylak** sizga shunchalik **yoqqan** bo'lsa, nega sotib olmaysiz?

sentences.text: My grandfather **reads the news** a lot, but he doesn't **trust it** very much.

examples.title: Verb + object + **well**, **quickly**, **carefully**
examples.description: «Qanday?» degan ravish to'ldiruvchidan keyin: speaks **English very well**, read **the instructions carefully**. O'zbekchada ravish fe'ldan oldin turadi.

sentences.text: She **speaks English** very well.
Aziz **plays the guitar** beautifully.
Please **read the instructions** carefully.
Tom **did the test** quickly and left early.
My mother **cooks plov** better than anyone.
You **know this city** well — can you show us around?
sentences.translation: Siz bu **shaharni** yaxshi **bilasiz** — bizni aylantirib ko'rsata olasizmi?

sentences.text: The children **ate their dinner** quietly.
Dilnoza **explained the rule** very clearly.
Could you **close the door** quietly? The baby is asleep.
Bekzod **doesn't drive his car** very carefully, so I'm worried.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **mashinasini** unchalik ehtiyot bo'lib **haydamaydi**, shuning uchun xavotirdaman.

examples.title: Long objects stay next to the verb
examples.description: To'ldiruvchi uzun bo'lsa ham fe'ldan keyin darhol keladi; joy va vaqt — undan keyin. O'zbekchada esa butun birikma fe'ldan oldin turadi.

sentences.text: I **bought a new jacket and some shoes** in the sale.
sentences.translation: Chegirmada **yangi kurtka va poyabzal sotib oldim**.

sentences.text: Madina **met an old friend from school** at the station.
We **visited all the museums in the old city** in two days.
sentences.translation: Ikki kunda **eski shahardagi hamma muzeylarni ko'rib chiqdik**.

sentences.text: Tom **left his bag with all his documents** on the train.
sentences.translation: Tom **barcha hujjatlari solingan sumkasini** poyezdda **qoldirib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Did you **read the email from the manager** this morning?
My parents **sold their big house near the river** last year.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam o'tgan yili **daryo bo'yidagi katta uylarini sotishdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **cooked a wonderful dinner for twelve people** on Sunday.
sentences.translation: Sara yakshanba kuni **o'n ikki kishiga ajoyib kechki ovqat tayyorladi**.

sentences.text: Don't **forget the tickets and your passport** tomorrow!
The police **found the stolen car** two kilometres away.
Every evening Aziz **washes the dishes and takes out the rubbish**.
sentences.translation: Har kuni kechqurun Aziz **idishlarni yuvadi va axlatni chiqaradi**.

examples.title: Place before time: **to work every day**
examples.description: Joy oldin, vaqt keyin: go **to the gym three times a week**, arrived **in London at six**. O'zbekchada odatda teskari: «haftasiga uch marta sport zaliga».

sentences.text: Aziz goes **to the gym three times a week**.
sentences.translation: Aziz **haftasiga uch marta sport zaliga** boradi.

sentences.text: We arrived **in London at six in the morning**.
sentences.translation: Biz **Londonga ertalab soat oltida** yetib keldik.

sentences.text: Dilnoza was born **in Samarkand in 1998**.
Are you going **to the party on Friday**?
My father comes **home at nine** most evenings.
sentences.translation: Dadam ko'p kechalari **uyga soat to'qqizda** keladi.

sentences.text: Let's meet **outside the cinema at seven**.
James has lived **in Manchester since 2019**.
The children were **at school all day**.
I left my umbrella **in the café yesterday**.
We're flying **to Istanbul next Tuesday** and coming back **on Sunday**.
sentences.translation: **Kelasi seshanba Istanbulga** uchamiz va **yakshanba kuni** qaytamiz.

examples.title: Time at the start: **Last summer** we went ...
examples.description: Vaqt ifodasi gap boshida ham kela oladi — bu o'zbekchaga yaqin. Lekin keyingi qismda tartib o'zgarmaydi: ega + fe'l + to'ldiruvchi + joy.

sentences.text: **Last summer** we went to Khiva for a week.
**On Saturday mornings** I play tennis with my brother.
sentences.translation: **Shanba kunlari ertalab** akam bilan tennis o'ynayman.

sentences.text: **In 2020** Madina moved to Tashkent.
**Every evening** my grandmother waters the flowers in the garden.
sentences.translation: **Har kuni kechqurun** buvim bog'dagi gullarga suv quyadi.

sentences.text: **Yesterday** I saw Tom at the bus stop.
**At the weekend** we're visiting our cousins in Bukhara.
**Two years ago** Aziz started his own business.
sentences.translation: **Ikki yil oldin** Aziz o'z biznesini boshladi.

sentences.text: **Tomorrow** the shops are closing early because of the holiday.
sentences.translation: **Ertaga** bayram munosabati bilan do'konlar erta yopiladi.

sentences.text: **In the morning** I usually drink coffee, but **in the evening** I prefer tea.
sentences.translation: **Ertalab** odatda qahva ichaman, **kechqurun** esa choyni afzal ko'raman.

sentences.text: **When I was a child**, I spent every summer at my grandparents' house.
sentences.translation: **Bolaligimda** har yozni bobom va buvimning uyida o'tkazardim.

examples.title: Uzbek order vs English order
examples.description: O'zbekchada **to'ldiruvchi + fe'l** gap oxirida, inglizchada esa egadan keyin darhol. Qalin qismlarni solishtiring: ular ikki tilda gapning qarama-qarshi tomonida.

sentences.text: Lola **bought a cake** at the bakery this morning.
sentences.translation: Lola bugun ertalab novvoyxonadan **tort sotib oldi**.

sentences.text: We **watched a comedy** at the cinema last night.
My brother **repaired my bike** in the garage on Sunday.
Did you **see Tom** at the meeting yesterday?
Madina **teaches English** at a school in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Madina Farg'onadagi maktabda **ingliz tilidan dars beradi**.

sentences.text: The tourists **took a lot of photos** in Registan Square.
I **did my homework** in the library after classes.
Sardor **plays football** with his friends in the park every Sunday.
sentences.translation: Sardor har yakshanba parkda do'stlari bilan **futbol o'ynaydi**.

sentences.text: Emma **left her keys** on the kitchen table again this morning.
sentences.translation: Emma bugun ertalab yana **kalitlarini** oshxona stoli ustida **qoldirib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is learning Chinese** at evening classes this year, and he loves it.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bu yil kechki kurslarda **xitoy tilini o'rganyapti** va bu unga juda yoqadi.

examples.title: Questions: Did you **see Tom** at the party?
examples.description: Savolda ham fe'l va to'ldiruvchi ajralmaydi: yordamchi fe'l + ega + **fe'l + to'ldiruvchi** + joy + vaqt. Savol → qisqa javob.

sentences.text: Do you **speak French** well? — No, only a little.
Where did you **buy that jacket**? — At a small shop in Oxford.
When do you **visit your parents**? — Usually on Sundays.
Did Aziz **pass his driving test** last week? — Yes, he did!
sentences.translation: Aziz o'tgan hafta **haydovchilik imtihonidan o'tdimi**? — Ha, o'tdi!

sentences.text: Have you **tried plov** in Tashkent? — Yes, twice. It was amazing!
sentences.translation: Toshkentda **palov tatib ko'rganmisiz**? — Ha, ikki marta. Ajoyib edi!

sentences.text: Can you **play the piano**? — Yes, but not very well.
sentences.translation: **Pianino chala olasizmi**? — Ha, lekin unchalik yaxshi emas.

sentences.text: Why did you **sell your car**? — Because I walk to work now.
sentences.translation: Nega **mashinangizni sotdingiz**? — Chunki endi ishga piyoda boraman.

sentences.text: How often does Sarah **check her email**? — Every hour!
sentences.translation: Sara **elektron pochtasini** qanchalik tez-tez **tekshiradi**? — Har soatda!

sentences.text: Did you **lock the door** when you left? — I think so.
Are you **watching the match** at home tonight? — No, at Bekzod's.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **o'yinni** uyda **tomosha qilasizmi**? — Yo'q, Bekzodnikida.

examples.title: Mixed: verb, object, place and time
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ega + fe'l + to'ldiruvchi + qanday + joy + vaqt; vaqt gap boshida ham.

sentences.text: Aziz **reads a book** in bed every night.
I **don't like coffee** very much, but I drink it at work.
On Friday evening Madina **cooked plov** for all her neighbours.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni kechqurun Madina barcha qo'shnilariga **palov pishirdi**.

sentences.text: Please **put the milk** in the fridge immediately.
We **had a wonderful time** in Samarkand last spring.
Tom **speaks Uzbek** quite well because he lived in Tashkent for three years.
sentences.translation: Tom **o'zbekchada** ancha yaxshi **gapiradi**, chunki u Toshkentda uch yil yashagan.

sentences.text: Did you **find your glasses** in the car this morning?
My grandmother **makes the best jam** in the whole village.
sentences.translation: Buvim butun qishloqdagi **eng mazali murabboni tayyorlaydi**.

sentences.text: After lunch the children **played hide-and-seek** in the garden for hours.
sentences.translation: Tushlikdan keyin bolalar bog'da soatlab **berkinmachoq o'ynashdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **finished her report** at midnight and sent it to her boss.
sentences.translation: Sara **hisobotini** yarim tunda **tugatdi** va boshlig'iga yubordi.
